entries.title: Infinitary offers to screen events when an automation has an Only if condition
entries.body: When you save or turn on an automation with an Only if condition while Screen automation events is off, a card explains that every event still wakes your first mate. It shows what screening sends, and Turn on switches it on right there.

picture.alt: A card asking whether to skip events an automation does not need, naming its condition and what turning screening on sends, with Not now and Turn on
